contract: Actionable alt-data axis for the Mastermind bot. Each signal: signal_score 0-100 (composite of weighted convergence + brain conviction + price confirm − extension), action ∈ {ACCUMULATE,WATCH,AVOID}, direction ∈ {long,short,neutral}, source ∈ {brain,deterministic}. The bot sizes through its OWN risk framework; this is an input, not an order. Brain calls are graded vs SPY (see calibration). An extended name is never ACCUMULATE. trump_linked / affiliations flag actor ties. rolling_over names (off_high≤−15% AND 20d<0 AND below 50dma) appear in broken_signals only — crowd attention, NOT entries. entry_tier (T1/T2/T3) = validated confluence buy gate signal.
regime_read: The strongest measured convergence sits in enterprise technology and semiconductors, but several signals face near-term earnings risk and the track record has only two scored observations. IBM and MU offer the cleanest non-extended alignment; MSFT has credible convergence but is already extended.

signals.thesis: Five independent channels align: sharply accelerating federal-contract activity, positive insider positioning, a large patent cluster, developer momentum and model-download momentum [gov_contract_accel] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [github_momentum] [hf_model_momentum]. Relative strength is positive but not extended, preserving an entry, although earnings in four trading days create material event risk.
second_order: Enterprise AI infrastructure — IBM's contract and developer momentum implies continued spending on hybrid-cloud integration and supporting data infrastructure.
Government IT services — accelerating federal awards can support implementation, cybersecurity and systems-integration demand.

falsifier.text: Federal-contract acceleration reverses and developer or model-download momentum weakens without corresponding commercial growth.

signals.thesis: App demand, patent activity, the Sam Altman partnership link and a positive Trump-linked signal point in the same direction [app_demand] [patent_cluster] [actor:Sam Altman] [trump]. However, 60-day relative performance is above the extension threshold, so the underlying read is constructive but the entry is gone.
second_order: Cloud data-center infrastructure — sustained application demand implies continued compute, networking and storage requirements.
Data-center power and cooling — cloud and AI capacity additions increase power-delivery and thermal-management needs.
Enterprise software integrators — broader AI application adoption creates implementation and migration work.

falsifier.text: App demand weakens and AI partnership activity fails to produce sustained cloud or enterprise-software demand after the shares normalize.

broken_signals.thesis: Developer usage, model-download activity and patent formation align with disclosed political holdings and a positive Trump-linked signal [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [affiliation] [trump] [actor:Nancy Pelosi] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Michael McCaul]. The shares are not extended on the supplied 60-day relative-strength measure, but retail buzz is less independent than the underlying developer channels and should not carry equal weight [retail_buzz].
second_order: Advanced semiconductor manufacturing — sustained accelerator demand implies continued leading-edge fabrication and packaging demand.
Data-center power and cooling — accelerator deployment increases electricity, thermal-management and facility requirements.
High-bandwidth memory — AI accelerators require memory-intensive system architectures.

falsifier.text: Developer and model-download momentum rolls over while accelerator demand and patent activity fail to translate into continued ecosystem growth.

broken_signals.thesis: MU has the broadest convergence count in the pack: government grants, insider strength, a substantial patent cluster and a dense analyst-upgrade cluster align with bullish retail sentiment [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]. Its negative 60-day relative performance means the signal is not being chased, but affiliation with Ro Khanna is qualitative rather than evidence of a policy outcome [actor:Ro Khanna].
second_order: Semiconductor equipment — stronger memory investment would support fabrication and packaging-tool demand.
AI server supply chain — improving memory demand would benefit high-bandwidth-memory packaging and server-component ecosystems.

falsifier.text: Memory demand weakens while grant acceleration, insider strength and analyst revisions cease to improve.

disclaimer: An AI reading of the desk's own deterministic convergence — accountable and checkable, not a guarantee. Every call cites the channels/actors it is based on, is graded vs SPY over the horizon, and can be wrong or overconfident. The Mastermind sizes it through its own risk framework; treat as odds, not a forecast.
